title: Battling Build Failures? Discover the Power of SAF Technology
summary: If you’ve been hitting these roadblocks, it might be time to explore Selective Absorption Fusion (SAF)™ technology by Stratasys — a game-changer for high-volume, industrial-grade polymer printing.
body:
In the fast-paced world of additive manufacturing, build failures aren’t just frustrating — they’re costly. Whether it’s inconsistent part quality, warping, or low throughput, traditional 3D printing processes often fall short when scaling up to full production. If you’ve been hitting these roadblocks, it might be time to explore **Selective Absorption Fusion (SAF)™** technology by **Stratasys** — a game-changer for high-volume, industrial-grade polymer printing.

**The Hidden Cost of Build Failures**

Build failures don’t only mean wasted material. They also result in:

- Lost machine time
- Delayed lead times
- Reduced customer satisfaction
- Increased labour and post-processing

For manufacturers transitioning from prototyping to production, these issues are amplified. That’s where SAF steps in.

**🔍** **What is SAF Technology?**

SAF (Selective Absorption Fusion) is a **powder bed fusion process** designed specifically for **production-grade thermoplastic parts**. Unlike other methods, SAF uses an infrared-absorbing HAF™ fluid that selectively fuses particles only where needed — ensuring **thermal uniformity** across the build plane.

Key components of SAF:

- **Industrial-Grade Piezoelectric Printheads**
- **Big Wave™ Powder Management System**
- **Infrared (IR) Energy Absorption for Precise Fusion**

![](/assets/uploads/blog/battling-build-failures-discover-the-pow-picture2.webp)

**✅** **Why SAF Technology Minimizes Build Failures**

1. **Consistent Thermal Control**

SAF’s advanced thermal management reduces warping, shrinkage, and uneven fusion — common causes of build failure in other powder-bed technologies.

2. **High Material Reusability**

Lower powder degradation means less waste and more cost-effective prints, especially for long production runs.

3. **Designed for Prototypes to Production**

Part can be used or post-processed provides flexibility to cost effectively produce parts as they are needed.

4. **Superior Part Consistency**

Whether printing 10 parts or 10,000, SAF delivers consistent quality with tight tolerances — ideal for end-use applications.

**🏭** **Who Benefits Most from SAF Technology?**

- **Contract Manufacturers** seeking consistent throughput
- **Automotive Suppliers** needing strong, functional parts at scale
- **Consumer Goods Producers** working with complex geometries
- **Medical Applications** giving quality finished, durable, biocompatible and sterilisable parts

**💡** **Real-World Impact: SAF in Action**

A contract manufacturer using SAF reported a **30% reduction in failed builds**, and a **50% improvement in part-to-part consistency** over a 6-month production cycle — resulting in higher customer satisfaction and faster time-to-market.

![](/assets/uploads/blog/battling-build-failures-discover-the-pow-picture3.webp)

**🚀** **Ready to Leave Build Failures Behind?**

If you’re serious about **scaling 3D printing beyond prototyping**, it’s time to explore the power of SAF technology. With SAF™, you can control part qualities build-to-build in a way that optimizes part performance, consistency and ultimately production yield, leading to less waste and a lower cost per part.
